text:
**My pick is the Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Qi2 25W Wireless Charging Stand.** I couldn't open the WIRED roundup, so this rests mainly on Macworld's review of the Satechi plus one deal listing.

**Satechi 3-in-1 Foldable Wireless Charging Stand with Qi2 25W, $129.99** ([Macworld review](https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html))
- **Charging speeds:** The iPhone charges at up to 25W (Qi2.2). The Apple Watch module and the AirPods pad each deliver 5W.
- **Adjustability:** Macworld says no rival stands as tall or adjusts as much. The charging pad adjusts, and the stand folds flat for travel.
- **In the box:** A 45W power adapter, with US, UK and EU plug options.
- **Downside:** It's pricier and heavier than rivals, at 399g. Macworld says that's over twice the weight of the Kuxiu X40 and ESR Foldable.
- **Where to buy:** [Satechi](https://satechi.com/products/3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-with-qi2-25w), [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0GNRSY36V), [Best Buy](https://www.bestbuy.com/product/satechi-3-in-1-qi2-25w-fast-wireless-charging-stand-magnetic-foldable-for-iphone-apple-watch-airpods-space-black/J3GWC4C8TW), [B&H](https://www.bhphotovideo.com/c/product/1960497-REG/satechi_st_q25f31c_ea_3_in_1_foldable_qi2_25w.html) or [Walmart](https://www.walmart.com/ip/Satechi-3-in-1-Qi2-Wireless-Charging-Station-25W-Fast-Magnetic-Charger-Foldable-Stand-iPhone-Apple-Watch-AirPods-45W-USB-C-Adapter-Included-Space-Bla/19875453032)

**Cheaper or lighter options**
- **ESR CryoBoost 3-in-1 Qi2.2 25W stand:** A deal site lists it at $99.99, or about $82 with code PARTNER18 at ESR's US store. I didn't verify that code, and the site is a coupon aggregator, so check the price at checkout. [Deal link](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand)
- **Kuxiu X40 ($79.99) and ESR Foldable ($99.99):** Macworld names both as smaller, lighter and cheaper than the Satechi. I haven't looked at either one closely and don't have links for them.

**Which to choose**
- **Satechi:** Pick it if you want the most adjustable and sturdiest stand and don't mind paying for it.
- **ESR:** Pick it if you want the same 25W iPhone speed for less money.
- **Kuxiu X40:** Pick it if you want the lightest, cheapest travel option.

Check that the model you buy says "Qi2.2" or "25W". Plain Qi2 stands top out at 15W for the iPhone. Full 25W charging also needs an iPhone that supports it, such as the iPhone 16 or 17 series.
